definitions.explanation: A count of nine people. Usually read きゅうにん today; the older reading くにん survives in set phrases and in some regional speech.

examples.japanese: {九人|きゅうにん}{並|なら}んでいる。
{野球|やきゅう}のチームは{九人|きゅうにん}で{守|まも}る。
examples.english: A baseball team fields nine players.

examples.japanese: {十人|じゅうにん}のうち{九人|きゅうにん}が{賛成|さんせい}したので、{提案|ていあん}はそのまま{通|とお}った。
examples.english: Nine out of ten agreed, so the proposal passed as it was.

notes:
{九|きゅう} plus the counter {人|にん} for people.

WHICH READING:
きゅうにん is the standard modern reading. くにん is older and now mostly limited to fixed expressions; when in doubt, say きゅうにん.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {九人|きゅうにん}で: as a group of nine
- {十人|じゅうにん}のうち{九人|きゅうにん}: nine out of ten
- {九人|きゅうにん}{制|せい}: nine-a-side (of a sport)

RELATED COUNTS:
- {八人|はちにん}: eight people
- {十人|じゅうにん}: ten people
